[b]CORONEL MARQUES CHAMANDO TODOS SOLDADOS SERVIÇO[/b]
Uma voz robótica avisou, todos soldados saíram de seus quartos e campos imediatamente, e foram até o centro do quartel.
Em frente a eles, o coronel olhou para os lados para ver se todos estavam presentes, milhares enchiam o lugar, outros quartéis somando davam um total de 50000 homens, recentemente de manhã mais 10000 homens chegaram, e portanto agora o exército na ilha tem 50000 soldados.
Ele usava um fuzil IMBEL, o carregando em mãos, ele então começou.
[i]Por dias estivemos aqui, limitados a defender posições e levar ataques e ataques, mas já chega disso, não vamos mais defender, bravos soldados Bravanorianos, é hora de nós atacarmos, preparem seus fuzis e equipamentos, o combate na selva é traiçoeiro.
[b]AVE IMPÉRIO[/b]
Ele gritou e os soldados repetiram
[/i]
----------------------------------------
[i]ACORDA IMBECIL[/i]
Um dos soldados acordou outro batendo com o fuzil na cara dele para acordar.
[i]é hora de lutar e avançar[/i]
Ele ri, após os soldados se reunirem, entoaram o hino nacional e saudaram a bandeira com um gesto de despedida, a marcha começou.
[i]Nós somos estes infantes
Cujos peitos amantes
Nunca temem lutar
Vivemos
Morremos
Para Bravanor nos consagrar!
Nós, peitos nunca vencidos
De valor, desmedidos
No fragor da disputa
Mostremos
Que em nossa Pátria temos
Valor imenso
No intenso
Da luta

És a nobre Infantaria
Das armas a rainha
Por ti daria
A vida minha
E a glória prometida
Nos campos de batalha
Estar contigo
Ante o inimigo
Pelo fogo da metralha!
És eterna majestade
Nas linhas combatentes
És entidade
Dos mais valentes
Quando o toque da vitória
Marcar nossa alegria
Eu cantarei
Eu gritarei
És a nobre Infantaria!

Bravanor, te darei com amor
Toda a seiva e vigor
Que em meu peito se encerra
Fuzil!
Servil!
Meu nobre amigo, para guerra!

Ó! meu amado pendão
Sagrado pavilhão
Que a glória conduz
Com luz
Sublime
Amor se exprime
Se do alto me falas
Todo roto por balas!

És a nobre Infantaria
Das armas a rainha
Por ti daria
A vida minha
E a glória prometida
Nos campos de batalha
Estar contigo
Ante o inimigo
Pelo fogo da metralha!
És eterna majestade
Nas linhas combatentes
És entidade
Dos mais valentes
Quando o toque da vitória
Marcar nossa alegria
Eu cantarei
Eu gritarei
És a nobre Infantaria!
[/i]
Eles entoaram, todos soldados entoaram [i]o hino dos infantes[/i], enquanto eram transportados.

Os caminhões levaram os soldados até próximo da floresta, até onde puderam, e saíram, seus rostos eram pintados em verde, e uniformes plenamente camuflados como a vegetação,  alguns levavam morteiros de 80mm e 120mm , outros se levavam em botes nos rios menores, seu armamento era impecável, armados com  fuzis, metralhadoras, armas anti-blindagem e rifles de precisão, montados nas árvores, eles se rastejam entre a floresta, caçando o inimigo, enquanto recebiam suporte de fogo da artilharia, os tanques e blindados ficaram na cidade, já que em um ambiente fechado como a selva, é completamente inútil.
O coronel Marques, com a chegada também do coronel Valdir Assunção, eram quem preparavam e observavam posições,  helicópteros também eram usados no ar para levar tropas e espionar posições, mapeando assim a situação da frente de batalha

COLONEL MARQUES CALLING ALL SOLDIERS TO SERVICE
A robotic voice warned, all soldiers arrived from their rooms and camps immediately, and went to the center of the barracks.
In front of them, the colonel looked around to see if everyone was present, thousands filled the place, other barracks added up to a total of 50,000 men, recently in the morning another 10,000 men arrived, and therefore now the army on the island has 50,000 soldiers.
He carried an IMBEL rifle, carrying it in his hands, he then began.
For days we have been here, limiting the defender positions and taking attacks and attacks, but we have had enough of this, we will no longer defend, brave Bravanorean soldiers, it is time to attack, prepare your rifles and equipment, combat in the jungle is treacherous.
HAIL EMPIRE
He gathered and the soldiers repeated

----------------------------------------
WAKE UP, IDIOT
One of the soldiers woke another by hitting him in the face with his rifle to wake him up.
It's time to fight and attack
He laughed, after the soldiers gathered, sang the national anthem and saluted the flag with a farewell gesture, the march began.
We are these infantrymen
Whose loving breasts
We never have to fight
We live
We die
To consecrate ourselves to Bravado!
We, breasts never defeated
Of value, immeasurable
In the heat of the dispute
Let us show
That in our Homeland we have
Immense value
In the intensity
Of the fight
You are my noble Infantry
The queen of weapons
I would give for you
My life
And the promised glory
On the battlefields
To be with you
Facing the enemy
By the fire of the grapeshot!
It is eternal majesty
In the combat lines
You are an entity
Of the bravest
When the touch of victory
Marks our joy
I will sing
I will shout
You are the noble Infantry!

Bravanor, I dare you with love
All the sap and vigor
That is enclosed in my chest
Rifle!
Servile!
My noble friend, to war!

Oh! my beloved banner
Sacred flag
That glory leads
With light
Sublime
Love is expressed
If from on high you speak to me
All torn by bullets!

You are my noble Infantry
The queen of weapons
For you I would give
My life
And the promised glory
On the battlefields
To be with you
Facing the enemy
By the fire of grapeshot! It is eternal majesty
In the combat lines
You are an entity
Of the bravest
When the touch of victory
Marks our joy
I will sing
I will shout
You are the noble Infantry!

They sang, all the soldiers sang the infantry anthem, while they were being transported.

The trucks took the soldiers as far as they could into the forest, and they went, their faces were painted green, and their uniforms completely camouflaged like the vegetation, some carried 80mm and 120mm rounds, others were carried in boats on the smaller rivers, their weaponry was impeccable, armed with rifles, sniper rifles, anti-armor weapons and precision rifles, mounted on the trees, they crawled through the forest, hunting the enemy, while I received fire support from the artillery, the tanks and armored vehicles remained in the city, since in a closed environment like the jungle, it is completely useless. Colonel Marques, with the arrival of Colonel Valdir Assunção, was the one who prepared and observed positions, helicopters were also used in the air to carry troops and spy on positions, thus mapping the situation on the battlefront.

[b]The Arenett Straight, Ugos Island |[/b] [i]2:00, 1 hour before the 'Invasion of the Raj'[/i]

[u]_               _ _ _              _[/u]

"Alright, I think it's about time to start moving in our ships. Get the coast guard ready in the south, and around the islands. I have a feeling they might attack from the south." Said Karcson, "Yes sir!" Answered the General of the Red Navy. The Naval general commanded the ships to start heading into position, and get ready to engage. "Oh, and one more thing, launch the missiles. Only half. 150 of them." Added Karcson, "They won't even know what hit them." Almost 5 minutes later- [b]FSHHHHERRR!!!![/b] Not one, or two, but one hundred! Over one-hundred missiles flew into view, spread in the sky like butter on blue toast. It looked like the sky was filled with them, and filled with smoke. The sky almost turned Grey with the smoke and smog left by the missiles. "Incredible" they both said in perfect sync. [b][BOOM][/b] The reconnaissance commissioner opened the door with emergency, "SIR, the enemy warships are secretly advancing towards us on the arenett straight!-" The Navy General rushed back to the phone to alert the ships of the offensive, "ENEMY SHIPS ADVANCING TO YOUR LOCATION, STOP THE ADVANCE IMMIEDIATELY AND ACTIVATE THE ORANGE PROTOCALL. THE KNOWN SHIPS ARE AS PROVIDED:" the general paused as he never got that information, "[i][whisper][/i] What are the known enemy warships?" The reconnaissance commissioner took the phone and provided the information. "The enemy warships [b]may[/b] include: 7 battleships, 12 destroyers, and 12 cruisers. The total amount is unknown, but the estimate is about 30-45. Again, use "Protocall Orange." He hung up. For all they knew, is that the Gendarmite National Navy was advancing upon the also advancing Red Navy.

[b][I]30 minutes later, on the water[/i][/b]

[u]_               _ _ _              _[/u]

[b][Bleeeeerrrrrrlch!][/b] [b][Bleeeeerrrrrrlch!][/b] [b][Bleeeeerrrrrrlch!] [Radio static][/b] "[i][u]ATTENTION, ALL CREW MEMBERS TO YOUR STATIONS, AN ENEMY WARSHIP HAS BEEN SEEN! I REPEAT, AN ENEMY WARSHIP HAS BEEN SEEN! [/u][/i]" "GET UP IREN, ARE YOU DEAF? DID YOU NOT HEAR WHAT HE SAID!" Yelled a fellow mate as he passed by Iren's room. "I'm awake!" And almost immediately put on his vest and outfit, equipped his sidearm, and ran out of the door. Screams and alarms were heard as they all ran though the large cruiser. "What's going on?" Iren asked to another mate, as they both ran through the long halls. "Haven't you heard, you idiot, someone's attacking us!" "No one is attacking us yet! But there are enemy warships in the area." Another mate corrected from behind, following them through the crammed halls. "Bah whatever, just focus on what we're doing."[/quote]

[b]Ignition[/b]

[i]"[b]Commodore Chastain, we've detected multiple warships administered by the Arenett Federation![/b]" yelled one of the multiple Radar Operators that filled room. Commodore Vikram Chastain approached one of the computers before squinting his eyes harder to get a better look at the situation. "[b]They've spotted us!, activate all combat manueveres, we have some tangos that want trouble![/b]" Commodore Vikram operated the GCV L'Indraprastha, the largest and most powerful flagship within the Gendarmite Rajian Navy. Accommodated by a small fighting force for 10 other ships whose classifications remained confidential to the Gendarmite Navy. Vikram grabbed the megaphone when the Naval Fleet approached 2 Kilometres of the Arenett Fleet. "[b]This is Gendarmite Administered Waters, return to your designated activity zones or there will be harsh consequences. I repeat. This is Gendarmite Administered Waters, return to your designated activity zones or there will be harsh consequences![/b]"

The NS Devoir II, a formidable Gendarmite destroyer ship was the first to approach the flashpoint between the Gendarmites and Arenetts. It readied its Batteries and Missile pods before sending out one bright and explosive warning shot that could be seen by the naked eye 5 Kilometers away. Soon after, the Devoir II would speed up its approach towards the Arenetts from 20 Knots to 40, it was followed by multiple other Gendarmite Coastal Defense ships who would support it if the Arenetts got any bad ideas.[/i]

[b]Mainland Raj[/b]

[i]The sound of sirens filled the colony, hundreds of people left their homes to see the illumination of hundreds of foreign missiles taking flight. The sight shocked Gendarmite military officials as it was the first ever foreign attack on Gendarmite land since the 2000s. Quickly, the mobilized SAM missile launchers began their attempt to pummel the missiles out of the sky. Hundreds of rockets flew into the air with their trajectory precisely aimed at halting any potential strikes on Civillian infrastructure.  The sky would fill like the new years, hundreds of missiles exploding like fireworks would make the face of war look almost beautiful. But not all SAM systems were perfect, and 2 stray missiles were able to hit their point in a Military Quarters severely damaging it. Another 4 would have mixed results all over Civilian infrastructure. 

With the attack being almost surreal with its proportion, Gendarmite radar centers rushed quickly to pinpointing and locating Arenett military facilities in an organized counter strike. Missile Projectors located in the Coast of the Raj would be activated while hundreds of terabytes of data would be fed to them by the Strategic Force. After almost 30 minutes after the Arenett engagement with the Gendarmite strategic Force, the missiles Projectors would eject their rockets into the air, releasing a sharp hiss that bursted through the sky as if it was lightning. The strikes would mainly be focused on Military Centers, Logistical Hubs, Ports, and Arms Factories in a "Moralistic Retaliation" that mainly focused on leaving civilians out of the potential strike zone.
[/i]
